content:
After graduating in May with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, I began my role as an Associate Data Scientist at AbbVie . I’m excited to keep building AI systems that drive real impact across the organisation.

A huge thank you to Corey Bown, PhD  and Sarah Wohlman, PhD  for their support and for giving me the opportunity to grow in this role. Feeling incredibly fortunate to take this next step and continue learning from such talented people.
